title: 空主页办公模板与设置个人资料/Token 热力图

root_cause.home: Home still computed and rendered local Session-derived task counts, Token totals, trends, success placeholders and recent Sessions even though the authoritative account usage day projection now exists and Sidebar already owns recent task navigation.
root_cause.templates: The Shell already owned native blank reuse through startSessionFromRoute and native draft state through conversation.input.for(scope).setDraft, but Home exposed no office-template projection over those owners.
root_cause.usage: AccountSettings showed the identity bootstrap and weekly quota but did not consume T10 identity.usage.activity, so it had no truthful daily, weekly, cumulative or 12-month activity presentation.
root_cause.composer_frame: The merged Home extended Glass Composer below the native card with --emate-composer-frame-bottom: -28px instead of exposing the existing native composerStack as the one semantic owner shared by the Composer and workspace hint.

resolution.home: Removed the old overview DOM and its local usage, success and recent-Session calculations; compressed the existing hero and mounted exactly twelve responsive office templates.
resolution.template_handoff: prepareTemplateDraftFromRoute calls the existing startSessionFromRoute blank/Workspace resolution, obtains the native Session scope, writes one native Composer draft and lets the template component focus the resident textarea. It never submits or dispatches a message.
resolution.usage: AccountSettings requests the exact T10 identity.usage.activity endpoint for an inclusive prior-year window of at most 366 dates, validates exact snake_case fields and canonical decimal strings with BigInt, reconciles every day and period total, and renders zero plus four activity levels with exact accessible tooltips.
resolution.presentation: Daily, Monday-based weekly and cumulative summaries reuse the same validated day buckets; loading, invalid response, typed unavailable and retry states display no fabricated heatmap or zero-success fallback.
resolution.identity: The enterprise display_name and weekly_token_limit remain bootstrap-owned. The existing user-selected avatar stays explicitly device-local and is not represented as an enterprise avatar.
resolution.composer_frame: Home marks its existing exact native composerStack portal target as data-emate-composer-frame-host for the target lifetime. That one native container already owns conversation.composer.bar and conversation.hero.workspace; no DOM child is moved or duplicated, and the negative frame extension is removed.

owner_contract.usage_owner: T10 identity.usage.activity over the account usage-attempt ledger

activity_contract.timezone: browser-resolved IANA timezone with UTC fallback
activity_contract.range: previous local anniversary plus one day through current local date; inclusive, 365 or 366 dates
activity_contract.count_encoding: canonical unsigned decimal strings validated and aggregated with BigInt
activity_contract.unavailable_policy: truthful error plus explicit retry; no cells or fake zero totals
